meta.negative_result_boundary: No direct list match in this snapshot means only that the deterministic screen found no direct OFAC list match for the screened GIST owner identity. It is not sanctions clearance and does not address ownership/control effects.
meta.scope: Company-level GIST owner screening against pinned OFAC SDN and Consolidated Non-SDN Entity snapshots. No separate plant-level sanctions finding is emitted.
